name: RC-B10-0195/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and its requests. It backs Armenia's push for closer ties with the European Union and its wish to join one day. It calls for the June 2026 elections in Armenia to be free and fair, and it warns against outside meddling, mainly from Russia. It also asks for more EU money and support for Armenia, and for peace with Azerbaijan.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the EU to give Armenia more money, advice and election support.
- **Who it affects:** People in Armenia, especially voters in the June 2026 elections, and EU taxpayers funding the aid.
- **What happens next:** EU leaders and officials decide whether to act on these requests; the EU-Armenia summit in Yerevan on 4–5 May 2026 is the next step.
